notes.title: Patch note - v1.0.7
notes.content:
- Hot Fix: handle data for players who played the very first demo. If you've bought the game just now, or you didn't play the very old demo (before the 0.9.x) then you are good. If you played the very old demo and played full version before this update and feel something odd with the game's balancing, then you should delete the data in Slot 0 and start over (other slots are fine).

We've collectively crushed [b]7.1M rocks[/b]! Thank you all for playing the game!

Also, if possible, [b]please leave the game a review[/b], it would help me a lot! (A game must have a certain amount of review for Steam to promote it further, and tiny games like Rock Crusher often struggle to get those early reviews.)

There are more updates coming. There will be major content updates, but for now, I'm focusing on fixing bugs and QoL first. 
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch note - v1.0.6
notes.content:
- NEW: save slot copy and paste. You now can copy data from a save slot to an empty slot. It only copies total unconverted resources you collected, so it's great for experimenting with new play style or triggering Steam's achievements.
- Fixed: Quad Crusher skill now displays and applies correctly
- Fixed: Repeater Charge achievement now is reported correctly, just end a session by depleting Fuel to collect the resources and unlock that achievement (you must unlock Session Repeater first)

We've collectively crushed 4.8M rocks! Thank you all for playing the game!

Also, if possible, please leave the game a review, it would help me a lot! (A game must have a certain amount of review for Steam to promote it further, and tiny games like Rock Crusher often struggle to get those early reviews.)

There are more updates coming. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Hey, have you played the demo?
notes.content:
Hi, it's me, FVS, the solo dev of [b]Rock Crusher[/b].

The demo of the game has been out for a few days. Although I plan to keep the demo at least until the game's release, I hope you would try it as soon as possible and give me your feedback, the sooner we do it, the better the game will get.

For those who played the demo, gave me feedback, I'm very thankful for you all and I noted down all of your feedback whether it was via email, DMs, feedback form or online forums. They are all valuable materials that will help me develop the game toward the final version.

We also got luck that the demo was played by Wanderbots. I enjoyed his playthrough, a very thoughtful one. You can watch it here:
[previewyoutube=uzoat9O9RcI;full][/previewyoutube]

Please note that this is the very first demo of [b]Rock Crusher[/b], it mainly shows you the general idea of the game. Main content, QoL features, and fine-tuned balancing are still in the work.

You probably have done it already, but if you haven't, [b]add Rock Crusher to your wishlist[/b] so you won't miss the big demo update in the future, and the release with introductory discount.
👇👇👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456800/Rock_Crusher/

[h2]I released this roguelike tower defense game last year...[/h2]

Last year launched [b]Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD[/b], it was a success, and that enabled me to work on [b]Rock Crusher[/b]. The game is about to have a big update with lots of new content and a deep discount in a few days. 

If you buy [b]Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD[/b] then you will have the best price for [b]Rock Crusher[/b] on launch because they will be bundled together.

Check it out!
👇👇👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2453610/Towerful_Defense_A_Rogue_TD/

[i]Thank you and see you next time![/i]
